content_data.meeting_title: Mobile-First UX Strategy Review: Next-Gen Infotainment
agenda_items: Align on visual design language and branding consistency for new features
Discuss integration challenges with existing automotive hardware platforms
Brainstorm innovative UI/UX concepts for future in-car infotainment systems
Review current mobile UX audit findings for existing automotive interfaces
Prioritize key user stories for initial development sprints
key_decisions: Adopt a 'glanceable' design principle for all primary in-car interactions to minimize driver distraction.
Allocate resources to develop interactive prototypes for user testing within the next few weeks.
Prioritize voice command integration and simplified haptic feedback for key functions.
